references.text: The prophecy that the dead will awaken and their bodies will rise, which foreshadows Jesus' action with Lazarus.
Ezekiel's vision where the dead come to life according to the words of the prophecy, an image of Jesus' life-giving power.
God's command to the prophet to speak to the dead, mirroring Jesus' command to Lazarus.
Jesus' own prophecy that all who are in the graves will hear his voice and come out, fulfilled at this very moment.
The claim that the dead will hear the Son's voice and live, demonstrated concretely by the resurrection of Lazarus.
Jesus' command to a dead girl with the words 'Child, arise', sharing the same motif of a life-giving command spoken with great authority.
